ruleDefinitions.name: Node Process Executions
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of other scripts using the Node executable packaged with Adobe Creative Cloud

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\Adobe\\ Creative\\ Cloud\\ Experience\\\\libs\\\\node\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*Adobe\\ Creative\\ Cloud\\ Experience\\\\js.*"))
